info.name: Account Level Webhooks Book Commands User management API

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip from the beginning of the result set. Use this with `limit` for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page, starting from the specified `offset` value.

items.docs: This API returns a paginated list of pending invitations for your organization. Use this endpoint to review outstanding invitations before sending reminders or re-inviting users whose invitations have expired.

This API invites a new user to your organization by email. If the email has been invited before, the existing invitation is refreshed with a new expiration date.

> 👍 Tip: 
  > The invitation is valid for 7 days. If the user does not accept the invitation within that time frame, they will need to be re-invited.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip before returning results. Used for pagination. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records to return per page, starting from the specified `offset` value. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

params.name: is_manager
params.description: Use this parameter to narrow results by manager status. Set to `true` to return only users with manager permissions, or `false` to return only standard users. If not provided, all users in your organization are returned regardless of their manager status.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field to use when sorting the list of users. Use `id` to sort by the user's unique identifier, or `email` to sort alphabetically by email address. Defaults to `id` if not specified.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort direction for the results. Use `asc` for ascending order or `desc` for descending order. Defaults to `asc` if not specified.

items.docs: This API returns a paginated list of Dashboard members in your organization. Use this endpoint to review existing users, filter by manager status, or sort results by ID or email.
